requested_items.objective: Measure first-pass Nangate45 hierarchical physical feasibility for the complete compact-boundary 4x4 segmented mesh.

expected_result.reason: Replace linear single-router composition with aggregate placed-mesh timing, area, power, and congestion evidence.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require the compact top to observe one distinct payload slice and all metadata at every endpoint, with all 16 endpoints observed in RTL simulation. Accept physically completed or explicit bounded failure rows. Treat the 3.2 mm square die as a feasibility envelope, not an optimized die point. Audit whether hierarchical synthesis retained instrumentation counters; do not assume removal. Report boundary-register overhead and the absence of workload-matched activity, SRAM placement, and HBM/DRAM evidence.

requested_items.objective: Measure fresh Nangate45 hierarchical physical feasibility for the complete compact-boundary 4x4 segmented mesh after isolating it from the stale v1 cache.

expected_result.reason: A revision-specific FLOW_VARIANT must bypass the incomplete v1 cache and execute the full hierarchical physical flow.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require FLOW_VARIANT=mesh4x4_aggregate_r2 with independently retained ORFS provenance, all sixteen concrete routers and links, and complete finite PPA for promotion. Retain explicit bounded failures. Treat the compact traffic/observation boundary as disclosed harness overhead and do not claim workload-matched energy, SRAM placement, or HBM/DRAM evidence.

revision.replacement_contract: The revision-specific FLOW_VARIANT changes the parameter hash and ORFS directory so the evaluator must execute a fresh physical run.

requested_items.objective: Measure the aggregate 4x4 segmented mesh after making generic sweep cache reuse fail closed.

expected_result.reason: The unchanged r2 parameter path must be rejected as incomplete by the fixed cache gate and execute OpenROAD.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require the run log to report Re-running ineligible cached run for the retained r2 result, then execute OpenROAD. Require FLOW_VARIANT=mesh4x4_aggregate_r2 with exact new-source identity, retained finish/DEF provenance, all sixteen concrete routers and links, and complete finite PPA for promotion. Replace the prior parameter row rather than appending stale duplicates.

revision.replacement_contract: Keep the r2 parameter and result path intentionally unchanged; the source-aware complete-PPA cache gate must force the physical rerun.

requested_items.objective: Measure the aggregate 4x4 segmented mesh in a clean ORFS flow directory with self-contained failure evidence.

expected_result.reason: A new flow variant starts from a clean ORFS target; any failure must retain its return code, newest ORFS log tails, and result-directory inventory in result.json.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require FLOW_VARIANT=mesh4x4_aggregate_r4_diag, exact merged-source identity, and a new parameter-isolated ORFS directory. Promote only exactly one complete finite PPA row with retained finish/DEF, portable timing_debug_report.md path identity, and all sixteen concrete routers and links. On failure require make_returncode plus failure_evidence with the failing stage log tail; classify that row as explicit bounded evidence rather than silently retrying.

revision.replacement_contract: Use a clean revision-specific ORFS flow directory and the generic bounded failure-evidence transport merged in PR #1813.
